history.what: Planning docs: ARCHITECTURE, GAME_DESIGN, DESIGN, ROADMAP (39 tasks), CLAUDE.md, playbook, progress log. Original plugins 3.3.0 and 4.2.0 added under reference/.

Owner rules added: no women or sexual content anywhere; text uses only learned letters; scene levels follow learning progress. Content filter (src/learn/content.ts) applied to word packs, sentences and lesson texts.

T01.summary: The project now builds as a website and as an Otzaria plugin file, shows a placeholder Otiyot boot screen, and checks every pull request in CI.
changes: package.json, tsconfig.json (strict), vite.config.ts (relative base), pnpm lockfile
ESLint (no any), Prettier, Vitest unit tests, Playwright smoke test at 1280x720 and 375px
index.html + src/main.ts + src/boot.ts + src/ui/boot.css: placeholder boot screen and Otzaria detection helper
Folder skeleton from ARCHITECTURE section 2 (src/*, public/arcade, locales, plugin, tests)
plugin/manifest.json (id il.otzaria.otiyot) and plugin/pack.mjs: pnpm build:plugin writes dist-plugin/otiyot-<version>.otzplugin
.github/workflows/ci.yml: lint, typecheck, unit tests, build, plugin build uploaded as artifact, Playwright smoke
vercel.json, README.md, ASSETS.md, CHANGELOG.md, ASSUMPTIONS.md

decisions.decision: Pinned TypeScript to 5.x
decisions.why: typescript-eslint does not support TypeScript 7 yet

decisions.decision: Plugin zip made with the fflate library instead of a system zip tool
decisions.why: Works the same on any machine and in CI

decisions.decision: Plugin manifest is a trimmed copy of the 4.2.0 one with the new id, beta stability and no theme event permission
decisions.why: Only what the game needs now; permissions can be added later

manual_steps.title: Import the repo into Vercel
manual_steps.details: Go to vercel.com, sign in, click Add New > Project, pick the GitHub repo shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot, keep the detected Vite settings and click Deploy. Main becomes the live link.
manual_steps.browser_prompt: Open https://vercel.com/new in my browser. Steps: 1) If asked to sign in, stop and hand control back to me. 2) Under Import Git Repository choose the GitHub repo shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot (if it is not listed, click Adjust GitHub App Permissions and stop for me to approve). 3) Click Import. 4) Leave Framework Preset as Vite and keep the settings from vercel.json. 5) Click Deploy and wait until it finishes. Stop and hand control back to me for sign-in, passwords, 2FA, CAPTCHAs, payment, creating an account and pasting secret keys; never type a secret yourself. When done, report the live URL and what you did.

todo: Playwright browsers install in CI only; locally run pnpm exec playwright install chromium first
T01.notes: No game code yet; the boot screen is a placeholder until T07/T12.

T02.summary: The typing engine every scene and mode will use now exists as pure logic: keyboard layouts for Hebrew and English, a session that judges each key, and scoring with per-key, per-finger and habit hints.
changes: src/core/layouts.ts: Hebrew (Israeli) and English (QWERTY) layouts by KeyboardEvent.code with finger, hand, row, shift layer, final letters, niqqud helpers, key lookup by character and text normaliser

src/core/session.ts: TypingSession (judged TypedKey out, errors never block, backspace policy allowed/disabled/mustFix, hardcore flag, niqqud ignore/required, works whatever the OS keyboard language is)
src/core/metrics.ts: gross and net WPM, accuracy, consistency, WPM timeline, rolling WPM, per-key and per-finger stats, confusion pairs, wrong-finger / home-row-drift / slow-key hints
tests/unit/core-layouts.test.ts and tests/unit/core-session.test.ts: 46 new tests incl. recorded Hebrew and English sessions and mixed Hebrew/English lines
docs/ROADMAP.md: T02 ticked

decisions.decision: The session takes the time as an argument instead of reading a clock
decisions.why: Keeps core pure and makes recorded-session tests exact

decisions.decision: Kept the reference shift layer (( on Shift+9 for Hebrew) and the swapped < > ; added mirrored brackets and backslash
decisions.why: Port behaviour from 4.2.0; brackets were missing there

decisions.decision: Niqqud marks can be typed in any order and a letter typed while marks are owed counts as a missed mark
decisions.why: Errors must never block the player

decisions.decision: Net WPM = gross WPM minus mistakes per minute, as in the 4.2.0 engine
decisions.why: Keeps scores comparable with the old plugin

T02.notes: Timing-based hints use simple thresholds; T06 (adaptive engine) may tune them.

T03.summary: Saves now exist as pure logic: several local profiles, a versioned save with migrations, browser and Otzaria storage chosen at boot, autosave that keeps the last good copy, JSON export/import and a one-time import of old plugin progress.
changes: src/save/schema.ts: Save/Profile types from ARCHITECTURE section 4, defaults, tolerant normaliser that repairs bad fields
src/save/migrations.ts: CURRENT_VERSION 1, migration chain, v0 (unversioned) to v1, refuses saves from newer versions
src/save/store.ts: SaveStore with localStorage, Otzaria (storage.get/set with a local mirror) and memory adapters; detectStore picks at boot
src/save/manager.ts: SaveManager with load + recovery (primary, then last good copy, then fresh), debounced autosave, profile create/rename/delete/switch, export/import JSON
src/save/legacy.ts: one-time import of old plugin progress (hebtyper_data_v2) into a new profile
src/main.ts: creates the SaveManager at boot, loads it, flushes on pagehide
tests/unit/save-*.test.ts: 40 new tests (round-trip, migration, corrupt recovery, both adapters with a mocked Otzaria, profiles, export/import, legacy import)
docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, CHANGELOG.md updated

decisions.decision: Version 0 is the unversioned early shape and the current version is 1
decisions.why: There was no older released format; this proves the migration chain works and leaves a clear place for the next change

decisions.decision: Hand-written validation instead of adding a schema library
decisions.why: Keeps the bundle small and avoids a new dependency; the normaliser repairs fields instead of rejecting the whole save

decisions.decision: Every autosave first copies the previous good save to a backup key
decisions.why: A half-written main save can then always be recovered from the last good copy

decisions.decision: A broken or too-new save is kept under otiyot_save_unreadable and a too-new save is never overwritten
decisions.why: Nothing the player earned is lost by an update or a downgrade

decisions.decision: Importing a profile file adds profiles (new ids on clash) unless replace is asked for
decisions.why: Safer: importing can never wipe existing profiles by accident

decisions.decision: Deleting the last profile creates a fresh one
decisions.why: The game always has a player

decisions.decision: Added meta.legacyChecked and createdAt to the schema
decisions.why: Makes the old-plugin import happen once only

todo: The UI for choosing, creating, renaming and exporting profiles comes with the design system and title screen (T07, T12)
Legacy import maps statistics and completed lessons only; old lesson ids are kept as they are and will be matched to the new tracks in T04
T03.notes: Typed text is never stored. The manager is exported from src/main.ts as `saves` for later tasks.

T04.summary: Both built-in lesson courses now exist as pure logic for Hebrew and English: Track 1 (letter by letter, from plugin 3.3.0) and Track 2 (two keys per lesson with real words, from plugin 4.2.0). Each profile picks a track, progress is kept separately per track and language, and a text source hands scenes the next text from the active track.
changes: src/learn/track.ts: TRACK_1 and TRACK_2 with levels, lesson lists, titles and tips in both UI languages, unlock rule (70% of the previous level), find-next-lesson, 90% pass mark

src/learn/text1.ts and text2.ts: faithful ports of the lesson text generators of plugins 3.3.0 and 4.2.0 (character drills, word drills, Level 1 lessons, pseudo-words, final letters, niqqud level) with an injected random source
src/learn/data/banks.ts, curriculum.ts, lexicon.ts: word banks, sentences, paragraphs, key orders, level names and the Track 2 lexicon, generated from reference/ by scripts/extract-learn-data.mjs
src/learn/progress.ts: per-track and per-language progress on the profile, record a finished lesson (pass/best), switch track without losing progress
src/learn/source.ts: nextText, nextContinueText and lessonForBand give a scene band its text from the profile active track

tests/unit/learn-harness.ts, learn-tracks.test.ts, learn-progress.test.ts: the original plugin code runs in a sandbox and its lessons, titles, tips, unlock rule and generated text are compared with the ports for both tracks, both languages and several seeds; plus switching, progress and content-rule tests
docs/ROADMAP.md ticked, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 5 and CHANGELOG.md updated

decisions.decision: The one niqqud sample taken from a verse (it contained a holy Name) was replaced with a plain greeting
decisions.why: Content rules in ARCHITECTURE section 8 are binding: no holy Names and no pesukim as typing text

decisions.decision: Progress is stored under profile.lessons["1"]/["2"] for Hebrew and "1-en"/"2-en" for English
decisions.why: Both languages reuse the same lesson ids, so they need separate lists; the existing save schema needed no change and no migration

decisions.decision: The active level is derived from the highest passed lesson instead of being stored
decisions.why: Same result as the old setActiveLevel on passing, and one less thing to keep in sync

decisions.decision: Weak keys, weak transitions and the difficulty level are inputs to the text generators, not computed here
decisions.why: The adaptive engine is task T06; defaults (no weak keys, difficulty 0.3) match a new learner in the original

decisions.decision: The 4.1 "keep unlocked after key-order migration" list and the frequent-word chunk drills were not ported
decisions.why: The first only migrates old saves; the second is not part of the lesson list and belongs with the adaptive engine (T06)

decisions.decision: Pass mark default is 90% as set in ARCHITECTURE, configurable per call
decisions.why: The old plugin used the accuracy-target setting capped at 97%; the roadmap asks for 90% by default

todo: T05 should extend src/learn/data/lexicon.ts (the Track 2 lexicon) into the full word library
T06 should feed weak keys, weak transitions and the difficulty level into TextContext and port the chunk drills
Legacy import (src/save/legacy.ts) files old English progress under lessons["2"]; it should use the "1-en"/"2-en" keys and map old lesson ids to the right track (L1-n = Track 1, L1p-n = Track 2)
T04.notes: Run node scripts/extract-learn-data.mjs && pnpm exec prettier --write src/learn/data to regenerate the data files.

T05.summary: A built-in library of over 4,000 Hebrew and 4,200 English words in themed packs and 360 sentences per language now exists as pure logic, with difficulty tiers, a key-limited filter weighted toward weak keys, and personal word lists stored on the profile. Every pack is scanned by a content test with a blocklist of holy Names.
changes: src/learn/library/data-he.ts and data-en.ts: word packs (everyday, home, market, numbers, travel, sea, sky, desert, holidays, nature, school; Hebrew also extra) and sentence packs (everyday, home, market, travel, sea-and-sky, desert, holidays, proverbs)

src/learn/library/index.ts: wordsOf, sentencesOf, tierOf, eligibleWords, pickWords (allowed keys, length, tier, pack, weak-key weighting), parseWordList, setCustomList, removeCustomList; older lexicon kept as the classic pack
src/save/schema.ts and migrations.ts: Profile.customLists, save version 2 with a v1 to v2 migration
tests/unit/library-content.test.ts and library-api.test.ts: amounts, packs, no duplicates, typeable plain text, holy-Names blocklist, filter, custom lists, migration
docs/ROADMAP.md ticked, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md sections 4 and 5, CHANGELOG.md updated

decisions.decision: Word and sentence drafts were written by Haiku helper agents, then checked by scripts and tests (letters only, final letters, no duplicates, blocklist) and spot-read
decisions.why: CLAUDE.md allows cheaper helpers for bulk lists; tests make the content rules binding

decisions.decision: Sentences are original short sayings, no punctuation or capitals
decisions.why: The typing engine has no punctuation keys in the lesson text and ARCHITECTURE section 8 forbids pesukim as typing text

decisions.decision: Tiers are by word length; row coverage is answered by the allowed-key filter
decisions.why: Keeps one simple rule; lessons pass the key set they have taught

decisions.decision: Custom lists capped at 20 lists, 2,000 words each, 24 letters per word
decisions.why: Keeps saves small; only words are stored, never typed text

todo: The Hebrew word packs contain some English-transliterated Hebrew words in the English holidays pack (for example shalom, challah); a native-speaker review of both libraries is worthwhile
Screens for choosing packs and managing custom lists come with the mode tasks (T31)
T05.notes: Frequency tiers use pack order and the classic top-word list only; there is no corpus-based ranking.

T06.summary: The adaptive engine is now pure logic in src/learn/adaptive.ts: it learns per-key, per-finger and per-letter-pair skill, picks weak keys and transitions, schedules spaced reviews, keeps difficulty near the 92 to 96 percent accuracy band, and builds drills deterministically from a seed. TextSource now fills weak keys and difficulty from the player's profile automatically.
changes: src/learn/adaptive.ts: charMastery, pairMastery, skillState, recordKeystroke, recordRetentionCheck, weakCharacters, weakBigrams, topErrorPairs, fingerSkills, dueToday, recordChallenge, difficultyParams, generateCharDrill, generateBigramDrill, generateErrorDrill, generateWordDrill, buildMicroLesson, unlockGate, adaptiveOptions
src/learn/source.ts: contextFor takes weak keys, weak transitions and difficulty from the adaptive engine unless the caller supplies them
src/learn/index.ts: exports the adaptive module

tests/unit/learn-adaptive.test.ts: 30 tests (mastery, weak keys, bounded over-sampling of weak keys, determinism, review dates, due list, retention checks, difficulty controller, unlock gate, micro lesson, finger skills)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (adaptive section), CHANGELOG.md, docs/ROADMAP.md ticked

decisions.decision: Spaced-repetition and challenge state is stored inside profile.srs as plain JSON, with no save schema change
decisions.why: profile.srs was reserved for this task and is already an open JSON record, so no migration is needed and old saves keep working

decisions.decision: Dropped the plugin's slow-common-words and chunk drills; word drills use the T05 library weights instead
decisions.why: The library already weights words toward weak keys; keeping two word pickers would duplicate logic

decisions.decision: Weak-key share in drills is clamped to 15-50 percent
decisions.why: Keeps the drill feeling like natural typing while still over-sampling weak keys, as the done-when test requires

decisions.decision: The unlock gate only blocks on keys that have at least 3 attempts and score under 70
decisions.why: A new player with no data must not be stalled

todo: Scenes and Practice mode (later tasks) must call recordKeystroke per key and save the returned keys and srs; the engine does not touch the save itself
T06.notes: Hebrew words in labels are not needed here: challengeLabel returns a code (guarded, growing, challenging, advanced) that the UI maps to locale strings later.

T07.summary: The game now has its real look and its menus: parchment and night-ink themes, bundled Hebrew and Latin fonts, every core component, Hebrew (right to left) and English menus, and a first-run welcome that sets up a player with a name, a keyboard and a lesson track.
changes: src/ui/styles/tokens.css: all design tokens (light, dark, colorblind, high contrast, large text, dyslexia font, reduce motion); base.css, components.css, screens.css use tokens only
src/ui/styles/fonts.css: bundled fonts from @fontsource (Frank Ruhl Libre, Assistant, Noto Sans Hebrew, Noto Sans, OpenDyslexic), woff2, Hebrew and Latin subsets only
src/engine/palette.ts: the same colors for 3D, kept identical to tokens.css and the DESIGN.md table by a test
src/ui/i18n.ts + locales/he.json + locales/en.json (179 strings each): language loader, direction switching, helpers for text that mixes Hebrew and English
src/ui/hotkeys.ts + src/ui/components/menu.ts: every menu item can be chosen by typing its gold letter, by arrows and Enter, or by mouse; Esc goes back

src/ui/components: button, field, toggle, slider, select, tabs, panel with deckled paper edge, key-cap chip, status, stat tile, progress bar, rank badge, dialogue box with portrait and captions, toast, modal, keyboard map and key heatmap, line chart, choice card (track picker card), menu
src/ui/shell.ts + src/ui/app.ts: top bar (back, player, language, theme), screen switching by address (#/menu, #/players, #/track, #/layout, #/settings, #/pause), one keyboard listener

Screens in src/ui/screens: main menu, players (switch, add, rename, delete), new player in three steps and first-run welcome, lesson track picker with a plain explanation and the real first keys of each track, keyboard picker with a mini keyboard, settings skeleton (Display, Sound, Typing), pause menu
src/ui/screens/styleguide.ts: #/styleguide page, development only, showing every token and component in light, dark, RTL and LTR
src/ui/theme.ts: applies theme and accessibility switches to the page
Save schema v3 (src/save/schema.ts, migrations.ts): settings gain theme, colorblind, highContrast, largeText, dyslexiaFont, with a migration and test
src/main.ts, index.html: boot now loads the save and starts the shell; the placeholder boot screen and boot.css are gone

Tests: tests/unit/ui-i18n.test.ts, ui-hotkeys.test.ts, ui-tokens.test.ts, a v2 to v3 migration test, and tests/e2e/shell.spec.ts (first run, Hebrew keyboard-only menus, pause menu) at 1280x720 and 375px
Docs: ARCHITECTURE.md (new section 5b and the settings fields), DESIGN.md, ASSETS.md (fonts and licences), CHANGELOG.md, ROADMAP.md ticked

decisions.decision: Menu letters also work through the physical key, on both layouts
decisions.why: A Hebrew menu must still answer when the computer keyboard is set to English (and the other way round); otherwise the gold letters would seem broken to half the players.

decisions.decision: Added five display settings to the save (schema v3) now instead of waiting for T36
decisions.why: Theme, colorblind, high contrast, large text and dyslexia font are part of the token system and must be remembered per player; T36 can build on them.

decisions.decision: New player steps are name, then keyboard, then lesson track
decisions.why: The track cards show the real first keys of each track, which depend on the keyboard chosen.

decisions.decision: On a first visit the three steps fill in the player that every new save already has, instead of adding a second one
decisions.why: Otherwise every device would start with an unused player called Player.

decisions.decision: Screens are addressed by the part after # in the address (for example #/settings)
decisions.why: It works the same on the website and inside Otzaria, where the game is opened from a folder, and makes every screen testable.

decisions.decision: The Journey item is shown on the main menu but faded and marked Soon
decisions.why: The story arrives in T12 and T13; a faded, un-restored item fits the world and is honest about what is not built yet.

decisions.decision: Fonts are declared by hand (woff2 only, Hebrew and Latin subsets, only the weights used)
decisions.why: The ready-made @fontsource stylesheets would also ship older woff files and unused subsets and roughly double the size of the Otzaria plugin. OpenDyslexic is the largest single file (115 KB).

decisions.decision: The styleguide is left out of the real build
decisions.why: DESIGN.md says it is for development only. To see it: pnpm dev, then open #/styleguide.

decisions.decision: Charts and the keyboard picture always run left to right, also in Hebrew
decisions.why: A physical keyboard does not mirror, and time on a chart reads left to right in both languages.

decisions.decision: The frontend-design skill named in the roadmap was not available in the unattended run
decisions.why: The design was worked out from DESIGN.md directly and checked by looking at screenshots at 1366x768 and 375px, in both languages and themes.

todo: The Journey menu item is disabled until the story and hub exist (T12, T13).
Sound sliders save their values but nothing plays until the audio engine (T10).
The pause menu is ready but only reachable at #/pause until scenes call it (T08 onward).
T36 adds the remaining settings (shake and flash sliders, text speed, health reminders).
The dialogue box has one generic scribe portrait; named characters arrive with the story system (T12).
T07.notes: Built by the Fable runner (Fable 5.2, effort High) on the second attempt; the first run left no branch. Website build is about 380 KB in total, of which 115 KB is the optional OpenDyslexic font. To try: open the live link, go through the three welcome steps, then try typing the gold letters, the language button and the theme button in the top corner.
